name: Optimization
description: Introduction to optimization, convex sets and functions, unconstrained optimization, iterative descent, convergence criteria, convergence rates, convergence analysis, gradient descent, Newton’s method, projected gradient descent, constrained optimizations, KKT conditions, barrier and penalty methods, support vector machines, soft margin classifiers, sub-gradient methods, proximal gradient algorithms, stochastic gradient descent, mirror descent, advanced topics/ applications – clustering, sparse linear regression, logistic regression, neural networks.
